Paragraph: "Look at the mango groves, Soumitri, weighed down by golden fruits that fragrance the entire forest!"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Viewing mango groves heavy with fragrant, ripe fruit.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama notices the abundance and sweet fragrance of the mango trees.
Outcome/Resolution: He pauses to appreciate nature's bounty.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Phala-Siddhi (Abundance and fruition resulting from nature's inner rhythm)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Abundant fruit symbolizes the ultimate sweet outcome (Phala) promised to those who remain steadfast in virtue.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Focusing on physical abundance in the environment to balance feelings of personal deprivation.
